items.title: Ray Bryant interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: Can you imagine Pavarotti coming out and going to his accompanist, you know.

ctx.x: You know we don’t delve too deeply into the sharp keys. Most jazz tunes are in flat keys.

I just think that’s so interesting to be on the stage at Town Hall, and the way jazz musicians work, you just go like this. Can you imagine Pavarotti coming out and going to his accompanist, you know.
